technology_name: Method for Regioselective Synthesis of 1,2-Disubstituted Benzimidazoles
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional synthesis pathways for disubstituted benzimidazoles require harsh reaction conditions, multi-step extractions, toxic heavy metal catalysts, and generate low regioselective yields.
description: A streamlined, single-step chemical synthesis protocol that utilizes an eco-friendly, low-cost Sodium Fluoride (NaF) catalyst to produce highly pure 1,2-disubstituted benzimidazoles at room temperature under ambient conditions.
applications: Pharmaceutical manufacturing pipelines, therapeutic drug discovery, agricultural fungicide formulation, and specialized chemical reagent synthesis.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
